FORM.AppraisalAddendumText: -::- -::- -:NEIGHBORHOOD MARKET CONDITIONS:- MLS RECORDS INDICATE STABLE PROPERTY VALUES WITHIN THE SUBJECT'S NEIGHBORHOOD. MARKETING TIME AND DEMAND ARE CONSISTENT WITH OTHER EQUAL MARKET AREAS. FINANCING IS AVAILABLE WHICH BUYERS CONSIDER MOTIVATING AND THE MARKET IS ACTIVE AT THIS TIME. ROCHESTER 14609 INCLUDES ESTABLISHED RESIDENTIAL NEIGHBORHOODS, COMMERCIAL CORRIDORS, AND A MIX OF SINGLE-FAMILY AND MULTI-UNIT PROPERTIES. THE AREA CONTAINS LOCAL BUSINESSES, PARKS, SCHOOLS, AND OLDER RESIDENTIAL STREETS. THERE HAVE BEEN NO SIGNIFICANT CHANGES IN THE REGIONAL POPULATION NOR IN THE EMPLOYMENT DEMAND THAT WOULD TYPICALLY AFFECT HOUSING PRICES. ONE AND TWO STORY DWELLINGS ARE THE MAJORITY STYLE OF RESIDENTIAL HOUSING. BASED UPON THE MARKET DATA FOR THE SUBJECT'S NEIGHBORHOOD WITHIN THE SUBJECT'S MARKET AREA OF THE TOWN OF BATAVIA. THERE IS INSIGNIFICANT FLUCTUATION IN HOUSING PRICES OVER THE LAST TWELVE MONTHS RESULTING IN A CONCLUSION OF A STABLE MARKET. SEE EXTRA IMAGE PAGE 1 TO VIEW MARKET REVIEW CHART CREATED USING THE GRAR MLS. -:HIGHEST AND BEST USE:- THE SUBJECTS HIGHEST AND BEST USE IS RESIDENTIAL. THE SUBJECT IS LEGALLY PERMISSIBLE, PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE, FINANCIALLY FEASIBLE AND MOST PROFITABLE. -:COMMENTS ON SALES COMPARISON:- DATES OF SALE ARE CLOSING DATES. THESE SALES ARE REASONABLY SIMILAR TO THE SUBJECT AND CONSIDERED TO BE GOOD INDICATORS OF VALUE. THE INDICATED VALUE BY SALES COMPARISON APPROACH, $178,000, IS CALCULATED USING THE FOLLOWING WEIGHTS: 26.4% - 515 GRAND AVENUE; SALE PRICE $210,000; ADJUSTED VALUE $202,800; GROSS ADJ: 9.1% 32.9% - 363 MELVILLE STREET; SALE PRICE $175,000; ADJUSTED VALUE $175,500; GROSS ADJ: 6.6% 40.7% - 460 MELVILLE STREET; SALE PRICE $164,900; ADJUSTED VALUE $162,900; GROSS ADJ: 3.6% THE SUBJECTS AGE HAS NOT BEEN BRACKETED YET IS NOT CONSIDERED AN UNDER-IMPROVEMENT FOR THIS IMMEDIATE NEIGHBORHOOD. THE EFFECTIVE AGE OF THE SUBJECT AND ALL COMPARABLES SALES ARE SIMILAR THEREFORE, NO ADDITIONAL AGE ADJUSTMENTS HAVE BEEN WARRANTED. THERE ARE A LACK OF COMPARABLE STYLE HOMES UNDER THE SUBJECTS TOTAL SQUARE FOOTAGE THEREFORE, THE TOTAL GLA (SQUARE FOOTAGE) HAS NOT BEEN BRACKETED HOWEVER, THE SUBJECT IS NOT CONSIDERED TO BE AN UNDER-IMPROVEMENT FOR THIS AREA. THERE ARE OTHER COMPARABLE PROPERTIES LOCATED THROUGHOUT THIS GENERAL AREA YET HAVE NOT BEEN MOST RECENTLY SOLD. THE ROOM COUNT & SQUARE FOOTAGE FOR EACH COMPARABLE MAY BE ESTIMATED AS THE INFORMATION FOR THE NUMBER OF ABOVE & BELOW GRADE ROOM AND THE FOUNDATION AREA ARE NOT CONSISTENTLY PUBLISHED. THE APPRAISER NOTES THE COMPARABLE BASEMENT SQUARE FOOTAGE AND BASEMENT FINISH IN THIS REPORT IS OBTAINED FROM MLS AND ASSESSOR'S RECORDS AND IS NECESSARILY APPROXIMATE DUE TO THESE RECORDS BEING DEEMED RELIABLE BUT NOT 100% GUARANTEED. THE SUBJECT WAS NOT APPRAISED AT THE PREDOMINANT PRICE FOR HOMES IN THIS AREA. IT IS NOT UNCOMMON FOR THIS TYPE OF HOME TO BE IN THE LOWER OR UPPER RANGE OF MARKET VALUE AND NOT BE CONSIDERED AN UNDER-IMPROVEMENT. THIS HAD NO ADVERSE EFFECT ON THE SUBJECTS VALUE OR MARKETABILITY. THE APPRAISERS OPINION OF REASONABLE EXPOSURE TIME IN THIS OPEN MARKET AREA IS UNDER 30 DAYS. THE APPRAISER HAS NOT APPRAISED THE SUBJECT PROPERTY OR PERFORMED ANY PRIOR SERVICES IN THE PAST 36 MONTHS.

VALUATION_METHODS._AdditionalDescription: Clarification of Intended Use and Intended User: The Intended User of this appraisal report is the Lender/Client. The Intended Use is to evaluate the property that is the subject of this appraisal for a mortgage finance transaction, subject to the stated Scope of Work, purpose of the appraisal, reporting requirements of this appraisal report form, and Definition of Market Value. No additional Intended Users are identified by the appraiser. This report was prepared in accordance with the requirements of FIRREA title XI, as amended, and any implementing regulations. The finished square footage of the subject above & below grade, is based on the appraiser's field measurements using ANSI criteria. The square footage for each of the comps is based on what is reported in the MLS and/or the assessor's record. If there is a discrepancy between what is reported in the MLS & that in the assessor's record, the appraiser has used the figures from assessor's records unless the MLS has documentation. It is not known how the finished area is reported in the assessor's record, nor is what is reported in the MLS necessarily based on anything other than a Realtor's estimate. These figures may or may not be determined based on ANSI criteria. The appraiser makes an assumption that the square footage reported for each comp is the nearest to what would result from their measuring each structure themselves, using ANSI measuring criteria. The subject's measurements were taken to the nearest inch or tenth of a foot. The total true taxes for the subject are $4,325.26. This information was obtained via the Monroe County tax website.
